description: This file defines the DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy class, which extends the PurgeStrategy class. It implements a method to purge records related to a specific employee identifier, by removing entities matching subordinate or supervisor roles in a human resource management system.

classes.name: DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for purging report data related to specific employee roles within the HRM system.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Purges entities associated with the given employee number, either as subordinate or supervisor, by removing corresponding records via the entity manager.
